mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which is typically associated with economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns despite low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) in more than 40% of cases over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates tight monetary policy, which can lead to decreased borrowing and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP and housing starts indicate strong demand, which should drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 returns are negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: The S&P 500 returns are negative when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales indicate strong consumer demand, which should lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 returns are negative when RSAFS is rising in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in non-farm payroll employment suggests a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 100,000 in the last month
failure_condition: The S&P 500 returns are negative when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates combined with low unemployment indicate a strong economy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 returns are negative when FEDFUNDS is high and UNRATE is low in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in housing starts during a late-cycle expansion indicates reduced demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth < 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: The S&P 500 returns are positive when HOUST growth is slow in more than 40% of cases.
